question: What correctly describes Neeraj Chopra's performance at the Paris Diamond League 2025?

options.text: He secured victory with his third throw measuring 88.16m at Stade de France.
His only valid attempt, 88.16m, came in the final round.
He won with his opening throw of 88.16m at Stade Sébastien Charléty.
He placed second with a best throw of 88.16m.

solution:
The correct answer is __**He won with his opening throw of 88.16m at Stade Sébastien Charléty.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Neeraj Chopra secured victory at the Paris Diamond League 2025 with his opening throw of 88.16 meters at Stade Sébastien Charléty.
 
• This outstanding throw placed him at the top of the leaderboard, cementing his dominance in javelin throwing on the global stage.
 
• The Paris Diamond League is a prestigious athletics competition that attracts top athletes from around the world.
 
• Neeraj Chopra's consistent performance and ability to excel under pressure highlight his expertise as an Olympic gold medalist and world-class javelin thrower.
 
• He continues to be a source of pride for India, showcasing his extraordinary talent in international competitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Neeraj Chopra’s major International Medals**:

 
 
• Olympic Games: Gold (Tokyo 2020), Silver (Paris 2024).
